purpose: Teach: 法廷/沈黙/欠陥/反射/偏見/中断/農薬/還元

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療事故、本気で、絶対、法廷、絶対、で、絶対、争われる、絶対、ケース、絶対、増えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, medical malpractice cases that end up in court are increasing. It's a serious concern.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Clear enunciation on key terms. Warm but clinical — the practiced clarity of someone explaining something important she's explained before. No condescension.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんの、本気で、絶対、沈黙、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、配慮、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the medical team takes patient silence and their emotional state into consideration during treatment?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, leaning in slightly. Hesitant phrasing — he's testing understanding, not showing off. Respectful attention on 'sensei'. Soft and thoughtful.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。医療機器の、本気で、絶対、欠陥、絶対、医療界、絶対、報告、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We maintain strict protocols for reporting equipment defects throughout the medical community.
lines.style: Declarative, professional. Light emphasis on 'strict' and 'protocols' — the confidence of someone who knows her systems work. Still warm beneath the procedure-speak.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療検査の、本気で、絶対、反射、絶対、を、絶対、利用した、絶対、技術、絶対、進化していますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So medical testing has evolved to better incorporate reflective techniques into the diagnostic process?
lines.style: Wondering aloud, genuinely interested in the mechanism. Slightly elevated pace on 'techniques' — intellectual engagement. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんへの、本気で、絶対、偏見、絶対、なく、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our team approaches every patient without bias, regardless of their background or circumstances.
lines.style: Calm, steady affirmation. Light weight on 'every patient' — a principle she stands by. Quiet conviction, not defensive. Eyes level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療の、本気で、絶対、中断、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、慎重に判断、絶対、されますよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the medical team makes very careful decisions about whether to continue or pause treatment?
lines.style: Reflective, almost tentative. He's recognizing something important in what she's said. Quiet respect. Pace slows slightly on 'careful' — acknowledging the weight of those decisions.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。残留、本気で、絶対、農薬、絶対、と、絶対、健康被害、絶対、医療界、絶対、研究しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our research focuses on the health impacts of pesticide residue and how to protect patients from those risks.
lines.style: Patient, methodical. Clear separation of each concept. The tone of someone who has watched this harm happen and decided to study it. Steady hands in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域への、本気for、絶対、還元、絶対、と、絶対、して、絶対、貴院、絶対、健康教室、絶対、続けていらっしゃるんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's why your hospital continues to offer those community health seminars — to give back to the region?
lines.style: Realization dawning, quiet appreciation. He's connecting the pieces. Slight rise at 'seminars' — genuine warmth. Trailing softly into gratitude.
